# Test pe mod commands - dependency management like go mod

# Initialize module
exec pe mod init github.com/myorg/myproject
stdout 'Created go.mod'
exists go.mod
exec grep 'module github.com/myorg/myproject' go.mod
exec grep 'go 1.21' go.mod

# Edit module file to add dependencies
exec pe edit --module github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless@v1.2.0
stdout 'Added requirement: github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0'
exec grep 'require github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0' go.mod

# List module contents
exec pe get
stdout 'module github.com/myorg/myproject'
stdout 'require github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0'

# Push module to registry (mock)
env PE_TEST_MODE=true
exec pe push --draft
stdout 'Module validated'
stdout 'Draft saved'

-- prompt.txt --
This is a sample prompt that uses helpful-harmless principles.

-- config.yaml --
prompts:
  - prompt.txt
  
-- go.work --
go 1.21

use .
